articles.body:
Hi,

Generated decision letters for 1 800 cases at 17:00 on Friday. The job is still shown as queued this morning, three days later. No error, no progress. We cancelled and retried once with the same result.

The regional offices are waiting to send these out.

--
Tobias Ahl
Architect, Regionalt Utvecklingsverket
articles.subject: Bulk letter generation queues but never finishes

articles.body:
Hi Tobias,

Found it. One case in the batch has a decision template that references a field removed in your last configuration change. The worker throws on that case and the retry loop keeps putting the whole batch back in the queue.

I have taken the offending case out of the batch and restarted the job, letters are generating now. The real fix is that one bad case should not stall the batch; we are logging that.

Regards,
Jonas
articles.subject: Re: Bulk letter generation queues but never finishes

articles.body:
All 1 799 letters are out. The remaining case is RUV-2026-0904, we will handle it manually.

Leave the ticket open until the batch handling is fixed, please.

/Tobias

articles.body: Keeping open per customer request, pending the worker fix. Reminder 22 Sep.
